rules.title: Berkeley owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners evicting a tenant for an owner move-in or to withdraw the unit from the rental market (Ellis Act) must pay relocation assistance. For 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.
citation_aliases: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.effective_date_note: Effective date of the 2026 inflation adjustment of the payment amounts (approved by Rent Board Oct 16, 2025); the underlying relocation requirement predates this.
rules.coverage_conditions: Covers rental units subject to the Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; exemptions not described in this document.
rules.conflict_note: Ordinance chapter number is not stated in the document; citation is inferred from the Berkeley Rent Ordinance and should be verified.

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board notice (Oct 27, 2025) of 2026 CPI adjustments to owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments ($19,413 standard; $6,471 additional), effective Jan 1, 2026.
